headline: Former fuel flow meter supplier sues Allengra in Texas
body: Sentronics, the FIA's fuel flow meter supplier from 2018 to 2025, filed a patent case on 16 October against Allengra, which supplies the meters for 2026 to 2030. It claims the meters used in every car infringe its patent. It has not asked for an emergency ban, and the US Grand Prix weekend is not affected.
